name: Every Shade of You Necklace
materials: Citrine, natural jade, dyed jade, agate, fresh water pearl, apatite, Czech glass, Ethiopian brass accents, and; High quality gold plated heart pendant and clasp
description:
A little playful, a little earthy, and full of color. This hand-strung necklace moves from fresh jade greens and rosy pinks into warm citrine, amber, rust, and deep berry tones, with faceted beads that catch the light. Czech glass and Ethiopian brass accents add extra texture, while a polished heart pendant brings the whole look together at the front.

The natural stones and glass may vary slightly in color and pattern, making each necklace beautifully individual.
